name: Rokusai no Mahoutsukai
source:
You are a witch living deep in the forest. Despite not having left for a long time, you venture into the city on the request of a benefactor. On a whim, you stop by a strange store and meet a boy with magical abilities who was being sold into slavery.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7912]Novel Game[/url].]
translation:
你是一位住在森林深处的女巫。虽然已经很久没有离开森林，但应恩人的请求，你还是前往城里。一时兴起，你走进一家古怪的店铺，遇见了一个拥有魔法能力、正被当作奴隶出售的男孩。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7912]NovelGame[/url]]
